extraction.name: FOMO60K
extraction.description: A large-scale, heterogeneous dataset of 60,529 brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans from 13,900 sessions and 11,187 subjects, aggregated from 16 publicly available sources.
extraction.creator: Asbjøm Munk, Stefano Cerri, Jakob Ambsdorf, Julia Machnio, Sebastian Nørgaard Llambias, Vardan Nersesjan, Christian Hedeager Krag, Peirong Liu, Pablo Rocamora Garc´ ıa, Mostafa Mehdipour Ghazi, Mikael Boesen, Michael Eriksen Benros, Juan Eugenio Iglesias, and Mads Nielsen
extraction.citeAs: To ensure proper attribution and recognition of the source datasets we kindly ask all users to cite the following papers: OASIS117, OASIS218, BraTS2412, 13, 15, 16, 32, MSD Braintumor19, IXI20, MGH Wild10, NKI28.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset is aggregated from 16 publicly available MRI datasets.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: When sequence metadata is missing, scans are assigned a generic name.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 16 publicly available sources including MGH Wild, SOOP, BraTS-GEN, OASIS1, OASIS2, MSD Braintumor, IXI, NIMH, DLBS, IDEAS, ARC, MBSR, UCLA, QTAB, NKI, and AOMIC ID1000.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Subjects were shuffled to protect privacy. For DWI scans, specific volumes were selected based on gradient directions and averaged to produce a single 3D image.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were reoriented to RAS orientation, affinely co-registered to the highest spatial resolution image within each session, and skull-stripped where necessary.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset will be updated with additional cohorts and modalities in future releases.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Brain Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scans containing cranial features.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Self-supervised pretraining, fine-tuning, and benchmarking in medical imaging.

rai:dataManipulationProtocol.evidence: To protect privacy and prevent easy identification of dataset sources, subjects have been shuffled. [...] For the b=1000 shell, three diffusion-weighted volumes were selected based on their gradient directions being most closely aligned with the canonical x, y, and z axes. [...] The corresponding volumes were averaged to produce a single representative 3D image.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: MRI preprocessing comprised three main steps: reorienting images to RAS (Right–Anterior–Superior) orientation, affine co-registration, and skull-stripping. All scans were first reoriented to RAS and affinely co-registered using the mri_coreg command from FreeSurfer 7.4.130, with default parameters.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: Skull-stripping was performed using SynthSeg31(FreeSurfer 7.4.1), which outputs segmentation masks of brain structures.
